description: A trader's lean-to grown outward over the years into most of a shop: a plate awning, a counter made from a truck bed, and shelves back into the shade holding salvage, cured meat, wire, rad-meds, seed, and boots in every size arranged smallest to largest. A hand-lettered card by the till reads NO CREDIT, and under it, in the same hand, EXCEPT FOR YOU, KESH, and under that a list of eleven other names.
name: The Barter Ground
